collection.title: SEAT Altea MPV 2009 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A SEAT Altea MPV 2009 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Claw wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Altea which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
